Before you inquire

A few helpful details.

How do I check if my date is available?

Complete the inquiry form with your preferred date and send your prepared message by email or Messenger. The resort will confirm availability directly.

Can I request a customized quotation?

Yes. Share your event type, date, guest count, accommodation and catering needs, and any additional requirements. Ask the resort which arrangements are available.

Are rates or bookings confirmed on this website?

No. Rates, inclusions, date availability, and reservations are confirmed by the resort. An inquiry does not reserve a space or date.

Can guests stay overnight?

The resort has guest accommodations. Ask about available room types, occupancy, and rates for your dates.

Where can I find the latest offers?

Check Treasure Trove Resort’s official Facebook page or contact the resort directly for current promotions and their terms.
